mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_trace_span (trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, span_type, span_name, duration_ms, status, metadata) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{spanId}, #{parentSpanId}, #{spanType}, #{spanName}, #{durationMs}, #{status}, #{metadata})
mapper.select: SELECT id, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, span_type, span_name, duration_ms, status, metadata, create_time FROM ai_trace_span WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT span_name AS agent, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS avgLatencyMs, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS successRate, MIN(duration_ms) AS minLatencyMs, MAX(duration_ms) AS maxLatencyMs FROM ai_trace_span WHERE span_type = 'AGENT' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY span_name ORDER BY totalCalls DESC

SELECT span_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) AS avgLatencyMs FROM ai_trace_span WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY span_type ORDER BY count DESC
